title: Analysis of the Frictional Performance of AW-5251 Aluminium Alloy Sheets Using the Random Forest Machine Learning Algorithm and Multilayer Perceptron
summary: RF and ANN analyze drawbead-simulator experiments on AW-5251 sheets across tempers, lubricants, roughness and orientations. RF R²=.90±.028; rolling-direction COF exceeds transverse; oil viscosity is the strongest input (0.59), then counter-sample roughness (0.30).
